original.target_description: Iowa Adoptee Study, men and women; physical or sexual childhood abuse predicting normalized principal-component SLC6A4 promoter methylation scores in regression including gender and gender-by-abuse interaction.

n.sample_role: Participants in target regression; exact analytic n not explicitly printed. Recruited biomaterial sample comprises 96 males and 96 females.
n.exclusions: Nine CpG residues with values in fewer than 90% of males or females and 36 redundant peaks were excluded; participant exclusions for the regression are not documented. Do not equate the recruited sample with analytic n or derive n from residual degrees of freedom.

replication.target_description: Non-overlapping Iowa Adoption Studies sample of 155 women; Table 1 full-sample Pearson correlation between childhood sex abuse (measure 1) and average promoter methylation (measure 3), above the diagonal. Physical abuse is not part of the replication predictor.

n.sample_role: Female participants in Table 1 full-sample correlations above the diagonal.

notes: Titles and DOIs verified in primary full-text PMC author manuscripts. Original analytic n is not printed and was not calculated from F degrees of freedom. Replication Table 1 supplies r = .301 but no p value for that bivariate test; the p = .0001 in Parameter estimates concerns a multivariable structural path and is therefore not paired with the Table 1 correlation. Table 1 lower-diagonal .329 belongs to the homozygous-long subgroup, not the full sample. Replication explicitly describes a non-overlapping female sample and a narrower sexual-abuse predictor; original combines physical or sexual abuse. Page numbers are supplied locators; precise section/table anchors are given because cached primary text is HTML.
